column2: State the main subject or theme of the lesson. This should provide a clear focus for the learning experience and link to the broader unit, curriculum area, or inquiry.

Include open-ended questions that encourage students to think critically about how knowledge is constructed, evaluated, and applied. These questions often explore the nature of understanding within a subject and are particularly relevant in concept-based or theory of knowledge (TOK) contexts.

List all materials, tools, texts, digital content, or equipment needed to support the delivery of the lesson and student engagement. Include any teacher-prepared materials and links to external sources or learning platforms.
